entities.name: EMM Procedures
entities.description: Mobility management procedures for EPS services at the LTE-Uu radio interface. Main functions include supporting UE mobility, location reporting, user identity confidentiality, and providing connection management services to SM and SMS sublayers.

entities.name: NAS Signalling Connection
entities.description: A prerequisite connection that must be established between UE and network before any EMM procedures can be performed.

entities.name: EMM Sublayer
entities.description: The mobility management sublayer responsible for initiating NAS signalling connection establishment when required.

entities.name: Satellite E-UTRAN Access
entities.description: Access scenario where GNSS fix time in lower layers can delay initial UL NAS message transmission by up to 100 seconds in cold state.

relations.description: EMM procedures can only be performed if a NAS signalling connection has been established between UE and network.
EMM sublayer initiates establishment of NAS signalling connection when required for EMM procedures.
In satellite E-UTRAN access, GNSS fix time can delay initial UL NAS message transmission by up to 100 seconds.
